SleufBase point-cloud editor: third-party notices
================================================

Potree 1.8.2
Copyright (c) 2011-2020, Markus Schuetz / Markus Schütz and contributors.
Source: https://github.com/potree/potree/tree/1.8.2
Release: https://github.com/potree/potree/releases/tag/1.8.2

The point-cloud renderer, picking, navigation, measurement geometry and
streaming workers are the original Potree implementation. SleufBase provides
its own editor interface and project persistence around this implementation.
Potree is distributed under its two-condition BSD license. The unmodified
license text is included at assets/pointcloud-runtime/LICENSE and
assets/pointcloud-runtime/build/potree/LICENSE.

PotreeConverter 2.1.5 (Windows x64)
Copyright Markus Schuetz / Markus Schütz and contributors.
Source: https://github.com/potree/PotreeConverter/tree/2.1.5
Release: https://github.com/potree/PotreeConverter/releases/tag/2.1.5

PotreeConverter and its supplied laszip.dll are distributed together with
their original license files in assets/pointcloud-runtime/converter/licenses.
These include the PotreeConverter BSD license, LASzip Apache 2.0 license,
Brotli MIT license and nlohmann/json MIT license.

The converter also requires the Microsoft Visual C++ x64 runtime. Windows
packages contain unmodified app-local release DLLs from the build machine's
Visual Studio VC/Redist directory, including msvcp140, msvcp140_atomic_wait,
vcruntime140 and vcruntime140_1. Their original filenames are retained.
Microsoft copyright, licensing references and exact file provenance are in:
  assets/pointcloud-runtime/converter/licenses/Microsoft-VCRuntime-NOTICES.txt
  assets/pointcloud-runtime/converter/licenses/Microsoft-VCRuntime-PROVENANCE.json
When supplied at build time, the original Microsoft license terms file is
included in that directory as Microsoft-VCRuntime-LICENSE with its extension.
The Microsoft files remain subject to the applicable Microsoft Software
License Terms; they are not licensed under Potree's BSD license.

Bundled viewer dependencies
---------------------------
The original Potree release's build/potree and libs directories are retained,
including original copyright/license files and copyright headers. They include
Three.js, jQuery, jQuery UI, Tween.js, BinaryHeap, D3, Proj4js, OpenLayers,
Spectrum, jsTree, i18next, plas.io/LAZ decoding, COPC/laz-perf, Brotli, JSON5,
and the additional resources and optional modules shipped by that release.
Their individual licenses remain in their respective directories. Texture
and other resource licenses are also included under build/potree/resources.

Source provenance and reproduction
---------------------------------
tools/pointcloud-runtime-manifest.json pins both official archive URLs,
versions, byte sizes and SHA256 checksums. tools/prepare_pointcloud_runtime.py
verifies those archives before extracting them. The generated runtime contains
PROVENANCE.json and runtime-manifest.json, including source versions and a
SHA256 record for every extracted file.

The runtime is prepared during development/packaging. Opening and editing
local point clouds in SleufBase does not download or upload these resources,
does not contact a CDN and does not require a KickTheMap account.
